goal: Reuse MAY photo/point/guide editing in an offline Android app; export a file and explicitly import into PC MAY
workflow: PC exports a selected work package with baseline and photos
Phone edits and preserves local draft offline
Phone creates a new outbound edit file via SAF
User explicitly applies to a new PC revision
PC recomputes results and preserves import receipt

keep: Existing PC calculation and persistence contracts
replace: PC network API calls with a bounded phone-local state adapter
do_not_assume: A simple remote WebView wrapper is offline

proposed_file_fields.packageId: Identity of the PC baseline package
proposed_file_fields.changeSetId: Unique outbound change set for idempotent import
proposed_file_fields.baseRevisions: Revision vector for the edited components
proposed_file_fields.baseSnapshotSha256: Digest of normalized baseline data under an explicitly defined byte/canonicalization contract
proposed_file_fields.photos: Source and displayed byte hashes, dimensions, orientation transform and safe local identifiers
proposed_file_fields.edits: Bounded finite original-pixel geometry, classifications, calibration, notes, protected boundaries and provenance

format_decisions.container: Versioned manifest with bounded optional image members; ZIP using standard libraries is a candidate, not finalized
format_decisions.phone_return: Can omit unchanged image bytes while referencing their exact hashes
format_decisions.arbitrary_archive_extraction: Forbidden; fixed allowlisted streams or safely staged controlled paths only

phone_safety: App-owned local content only; deny external resource/navigation/frames
Explicitly disable file/universal access; do not load content/file URI as trusted editor page
No broad native bridge; fixed operations and exact-origin schema/size validation
User-selected SAF URI read/write; no broad storage permission assumption
Private atomic local draft before export; cancel/error does not discard edits
Imported labels/notes are text, not HTML or executable JS
pc_import_gates: Strict types, finite numbers, coordinate bounds and data limits
Actual image hash/dimensions/orientation and PC ID correspondence
Exact base revisions and baseline digest
Preview before apply and recheck revisions at commit
Atomic new revision with recoverable prior state
Changed confirmation invalidation and PC recalculation
conflict_behavior: Do not overwrite. Preserve current PC data and incoming candidate, show target/diff, allow cancel or separate candidate review; no guessed auto-merge.
minimum_verification: Build/signing and actual phone offline launch separately verified
PC package to phone open, actual edit and local draft restore
SAF outbound file created and validated
Manual transfer and actual PC import preview/apply/reopen
Exact geometry and photo hashes/revisions/provenance round trip
Picker cancel, write failure and import failure preserve original state
dependency_check: Root limited receipt confirms existing API35/BuildTools35.0.1/JDK17 and selected CLI versions; Gradle absent from PATH, AndroidX/cache unknown. Author may supply a framework-only Java build script for independent reviewer to build with existing tools. No new install/download and no APK success assumed.
contract_finalization: Proposed field roles and ZIP candidate only. Author must freeze one bounded format/version and PC/phone agreement before claiming implementation compatibility.
historical_proposal_boundary: Field roles and ZIP candidate below are the preimplementation design reference, not an exact public serialization contract. Final implemented behavior is scoped by separate runtime receipt; do not infer every proposed field is implemented under these names.
